title: i18n: approval and audit texts still read object and option labels through t(), so a declared i18n.sourceLocale reader is shown the defaultLocale row (follow-up to #34030)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZiaBg6rk7dpy1s9Me

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding from the #34030 os-dev report (comment 7001158402, out_of_scope_findings class b), routed by the L1-a ACCEPT of PR #35351 (7002854859, out of scope (a)). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets lane and grade.

## What the user sees

In a deployment whose `i18n.sourceLocale` differs from `i18n.defaultLocale` (for example English-authored, users defaulting to zh-CN), an `en` reader of an approval request, an approval notification or an audit activity summary sees the object or option label in the defaultLocale language, while `/meta` and (after PR #35351) every validation and refusal message show the authored label.

## Why (read from source at the #35351 head; not measured at a public door)

PR #35351 (#34030) moved the objectql label readers and the plugin-security denial texts onto `translateObject` with the metadata route's resolve options (request locale, declared fallback chain, `sourceLocale` else `defaultLocale`). These producers still read labels through `t()`:

- plugin-approvals `readerLabelsFor` (object label via `t(objectLabelKey)`) and the approval-notification-text subject params.
- plugin-audit `activity-summary-message.ts` (field option labels via `t()`).

## Fix direction

The #34030 rule: resolve the label through `translateObject` with the same resolve options `/meta` builds, so `t()` carries messages only.

## Reader

plugin-approvals / plugin-audit owners (`domain:server`).

Dedupe: issue search `readerLabelsFor sourceLocale`, `activity summary option label sourceLocale`, `approval label sourceLocale t()` → only #34030 itself.
